notes:
Summary: LucidGate builds a low-latency personalization & in-app assistant layer for mid-market ecommerce platforms. Primary ask: run real-world perf benchmarks and a short POC that demonstrates sub-50ms p95 for single-turn queries and cost estimates for sustained 200 qps. Key constraints: user data never leaves customer VPC during POC; legal insists on data residency and audit log retention policies (90 days).

Call highlights (Feb 20, 2026):
- "We need deterministic latency — 95th percentile matters more than mean." — Head of Platform (Rachel K.).
- Target workload: 40–60 token responses for personalization & inline suggestions, occasional longer summaries (150–300 tokens) for product descriptions.
- Throughput target: sustained 150–250 QPS during peak, spiky bursts to 800 QPS; POC will simulate 200 QPS steady + bursts.
- Strong interest in Redwood Optimize features: batching heuristics, autoscaling, prefix/KV cache reuse. Asking for recommended batch sizes per model family and expected latency tradeoffs.
- Quantization: want 4-bit and 8-bit profiles evaluated; acceptable quality loss threshold = small drop in BLEU/ROUGE for reranking but human-perceived quality for assistant must be high.
- Cost sensitivity: finance requests cost per 1M tokens across configurations (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and rough break-even point for dedicated commit.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- Interested_products: dedicated + optimize + private (VPC).
- Security: SOC2, SSO (SAML), KMS + audit logs. Data residency EU for some customers; prefer region pinning.
- Quote: "If we can get p95 <50ms at 200 QPS with predictable cost, we can roll Redwood across 2 product lines this year."
- Action items: SE to share perf matrix + quant profiles; Eng to provide sample dataset and traffic shape; Legal chasing DPA (drive link shared).

Doc refs: pricing deck shared (drive://lucidgate/sales/redwood_pricing_v1.pdf). Fireflies transcripts attached for Feb 20 and Mar 1.

POC specifics agreed tentatively:
- Duration: 2 weeks perf run + 1 week tuning
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated in customer VPC (no egress of raw user data), optional on-prem connector for final validation
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail latency under burst, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens, quality regression on curated prompts
- Success criteria: p95 <= 50ms for single-turn short responses at 200 QPS; <5% quality delta on reranking tasks versus current model; cost at most 40% higher than current infra baseline for first 6 months
